snippet.title: Undertaker Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Made this short teaser trailer for my upcoming FPS game! Undertaker is a stealth-action FPS set in Transylvania, where you hunt eldritch horrors with both bullets and stealth. 

Play the demo now on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4234410/Undertaker_Demo/

Play my other free boomer shooter games:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/dobrx
